intro.fr: State of Decay a un outil qui randomise les traits de ses personnages.
intro.en: State of Decay has a tool that randomizes its characters' traits.

text.fr: Undead Labs sort State of Decay en 2013.
text.en: Undead Labs releases State of Decay in 2013.

text.fr: Le 21 juin 2014, TacoMagic publie sur Nexus Mods un outil qui randomise les traits des personnages dans le fichier characters.xml.
text.en: On June 21, 2014, TacoMagic posts a tool on Nexus Mods that randomizes character traits in the characters.xml file.
